role: The server-side dispatch interface for every play-state packet from the client: each process method is one C-packet's server half (NetHandlerPlayServer implements all 21).

members.name: processAnimation
members.note: swingItem on the server player: the swing fields and the S0B to other watchers; nothing the rows, the tick or this player's own client reads (the client swings its own arm, client_swing_item)

members.name: processChatMessage
members.note: chat input: the act stream and the native client carry no chat (GuiChat is client_cosmetic); a survival world grants no command a chat line could run but /me and /tell

members.name: processTabComplete
members.note: chat input, as processChatMessage

members.name: processClientStatus
members.note: the respawn and open-inventory-achievement branches on co->c16

members.name: processClientSettings
members.note: func_147100_a stores the translator, chat visibility and colours; its view-distance branch is empty in 1.7.10 (the integrated server's view distance follows the client's renderDistanceChunks in IntegratedServer.tick instead)

members.name: processConfirmTransaction
members.note: a refused click's setPlayerIsPresent(false) refuses the row's later clicks; the client's C0F answer restores it for the next row

members.name: processEnchantItem
members.note: the enchanting table is off in world.conf (a plain block)

members.name: processClickWindow
members.note: the click machine over the open container, then the S2Fs detectAndSendChanges queues

members.name: processCloseWindow
members.note: dispatched from surv_server_tick_start's close-op half

members.name: processVanilla250Packet
members.note: MC|TrSel (the merchant's recipe index) is ported; MC|BEdit and MC|BSign (book editing off), MC|AdvCdm (command blocks, creative), MC|Beacon (beacon off) and MC|ItemName (anvil off) never reach a survival server here

members.name: processUseEntity
members.note: ATTACK ids to combat.c:combat_server_attack, INTERACT ids to process_c02_interact, in arrival order

members.name: processKeepAlive
members.note: the latency average only (field_147249_f is the wall clock); networkTickCount, which the keepalive's % 20 correction reads, is ported

members.name: processPlayer
members.note: the full move-verification chain; dispatched from server_player_tick after the C0B actions and the confirm C06s

members.name: processPlayerAbilities
members.note: isFlying = packet && allowFlying: allowFlying is false in survival, so the flag stays false

members.name: processPlayerDigging
members.note: walks co->c07[] into process_c07 (drop 3/4, the dig machine, the bow/eat finish); delayed breaks land in surv_server_dig_update

members.name: processEntityAction
members.note: the c0b[] walk that flips sneaking and sprinting before the C03

members.name: processInput
members.note: NetHandlerPlayServer.processInput: setEntityActionState

members.name: processHeldItemChange
members.note: sets the server's current_item from co->c09_slot

members.name: processCreativeInventoryAction
members.note: creative mode only: the world is survival (WorldInfo's game type)

members.name: processUpdateSign
members.note: sign editing is off in world.conf (signs are placed blank)

members.name: processPlayerBlockPlacement
members.note: walks co->c08[] into process_c08 (in-air vs block form); the dig flow's C08 enters through surv_server_use_packet

notes: The act stream feeds these handlers through struct client_out (survival.h): the client tick queues what vanilla would have sent, and server_player_tick / surv_server_tick_start consume it in vanilla arrival order. Closed by lane/idxworld: every handler with an effect on this game's state is ported; the rest are n/a with the reason on the member. NetHandlerPlayServer's tick tail: the keepalive ping's id is the wall clock (func_147363_d, nanoTime) and changes nothing, the chat spam counter counts chat the act stream never carries, the kick timers never fire in lockstep; networkTickCount's % 20 correction is ported (player.h network_tick_count).
